subject: 30% Drop in Levels of Forever Chemicals in England’s Rivers, 49% in Fish – ‘Brilliant to See’
posts:
Environmental regulations deliver measurable victories as toxic forever chemicals retreat from English rivers and fish.
Evidence: Environment Agency data, chemical monitoring
#Environment #UK 🌐

International prohibitions and environmental agency monitoring have successfully cut levels of toxic forever chemicals by 30% in rivers and 49% in fish.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

Environment Agency figures confirm verified decreases in PFOS and PFOA concentrations across English waterways, validating regulatory efficacy.

Data published by the Environment Agency highlights significant reductions in toxic industrial pollutants previously pervasive in rivers and freshwater fish.

The Unavoidable Lie: Industrial pollution can be solved overnight without sustained, multi-decade enforcement.

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: 30% Drop in Levels of Forever Chemicals in England’s Rivers, 49% in Fish – ‘Brilliant to See’ ===

[Source 1 — www.goodnewsnetwork.org (Bias: Independent / Unrated)] (URL: https://www.goodnewsnetwork.org/30-drop-in-levels-of-forever-chemicals-in-englands-rivers-49-in-fish-brilliant-to-see/):
30% Drop in Levels of Forever Chemicals in England’s Rivers, 49% in Fish – ‘Brilliant to See’

2 prominent chemical compounds prohibited under international law over health concerns are being found at substantially lower concentrations in England’s rivers. Concentrations of these so-called ‘forever chemicals’ falling 30% in water and 49% in fish was “brilliant to see,” one researcher told the BBC, saying it was a marker for “how far we have come.” […]
The post 30% Drop in Levels of Forever Chemicals in England’s Rivers, 49% in Fish – ‘Brilliant to See’ appeared first on Good News Network.

[Source 2 — www.optimistdaily.com (Bias: Independent / Unrated)] (URL: https://www.optimistdaily.com/2026/11/bans-cut-two-forever-chemicals-by-30-percent-in-englands-rivers/):
Bans cut two forever chemicals by 30 percent in England’s rivers

BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY EDITORIAL TEAM Concentrations of PFOS and PFOA, the two most toxic forever chemicals, have fallen by 30 percent and 29 percent in England’s rivers over the past 10 years, according to new figures from the Environment Agency (EA). In freshwater fish, levels are down 49 percent. The agency attributes the decline […]
